mpi:
mpirun (Open MPI) 5.0.11

Report bugs to https://www.open-mpi.org/community/help/
compiler:
Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin27.0.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin
build_commands:
mkdir -p build/release
mpic++ -Iinclude -Ithird_party/stb -DOMPI_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -DMPICH_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wconversion -Xpreprocessor -fopenmp -I/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/include -O3 -MMD -MP -c src/main.cpp -o build/release/main.o
mpic++ -Iinclude -Ithird_party/stb -DOMPI_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -DMPICH_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wconversion -Xpreprocessor -fopenmp -I/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/include -O3 -MMD -MP -c src/image.cpp -o build/release/image.o
mpic++ -Iinclude -Ithird_party/stb -DOMPI_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -DMPICH_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -std=c++17 -Xpreprocessor -fopenmp -I/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/include -O3 -w -MMD -MP -c src/codecs.cpp -o build/release/codecs.o
mpic++ -Iinclude -Ithird_party/stb -DOMPI_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -DMPICH_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wconversion -Xpreprocessor -fopenmp -I/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/include -O3 -MMD -MP -c src/filter.cpp -o build/release/filter.o
mpic++ -Iinclude -Ithird_party/stb -DOMPI_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -DMPICH_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wconversion -Xpreprocessor -fopenmp -I/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/include -O3 -MMD -MP -c src/pixel.cpp -o build/release/pixel.o
mpic++ -Iinclude -Ithird_party/stb -DOMPI_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -DMPICH_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wconversion -Xpreprocessor -fopenmp -I/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/include -O3 -MMD -MP -c src/reference.cpp -o build/release/reference.o
mpic++ -Iinclude -Ithird_party/stb -DOMPI_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -DMPICH_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wconversion -Xpreprocessor -fopenmp -I/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/include -O3 -MMD -MP -c src/execution.cpp -o build/release/execution.o
mpic++ -Iinclude -Ithird_party/stb -DOMPI_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -DMPICH_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wconversion -Xpreprocessor -fopenmp -I/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/include -O3 -MMD -MP -c src/options.cpp -o build/release/options.o
mkdir -p bin/release
mpic++ build/release/main.o build/release/image.o build/release/codecs.o build/release/filter.o build/release/pixel.o build/release/reference.o build/release/execution.o build/release/options.o -L/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/lib -Wl,-rpath,/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/lib -lomp -o bin/release/parallel_filter
mpic++ -Iinclude -Ithird_party/stb -DOMPI_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -DMPICH_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wconversion -Xpreprocessor -fopenmp -I/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/include -O3 -MMD -MP -c src/generate_image.cpp -o build/release/generate_image.o
mpic++ build/release/generate_image.o build/release/image.o build/release/codecs.o -L/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/lib -Wl,-rpath,/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/lib -lomp -o bin/release/generate_image
mpic++ -Iinclude -Ithird_party/stb -DOMPI_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -DMPICH_SKIP_MPICXX=1 -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wconversion -Xpreprocessor -fopenmp -I/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/include -O3 -MMD -MP -c src/test_unit.cpp -o build/release/test_unit.o
mpic++ build/release/test_unit.o build/release/image.o build/release/codecs.o build/release/filter.o build/release/pixel.o build/release/reference.o -L/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/lib -Wl,-rpath,/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/lib -lomp -o bin/release/test_unit
mkdir -p bin
for name in parallel_filter generate_image test_unit; do ln -sf release/$name bin/$name; done
ln -sf ../scripts/benchmark.py bin/benchmark
ln -sf ../scripts/test_integration.py bin/test_correctness
git_status:
M .gitignore
 M Makefile
 M include/filter.h
 M include/image.h
 D src/benchmark.cpp
 M src/filter.cpp
 M src/generate_image.cpp
 M src/image.cpp
 M src/main.cpp
 D src/test_correctness.cpp
?? include/runtime.h
?? pixelz/
?? results/baseline-mac/
?? results/historical-linux/
?? scripts/
?? src/codecs.cpp
?? src/execution.cpp
?? src/options.cpp
?? src/pixel.cpp
?? src/reference.cpp
?? src/test_unit.cpp
?? third_party/
?? tiger_style.md
timing: prepared input to output; includes copies and all filter communication
stage_note: Each stage is an independent rank maximum; do not sum them as total
scope: single machine; no oversubscription; OS scheduling; background load uncontrolled
